semantics.purpose: Prevent duplicate active execution, not authorize external side effects.
semantics.release: work.completed / work.blocked / handoff.created releases or transfers
semantics.expiry: Expired lease returns work to available; stale lease is never proof of permission.
semantics.collision: Second claim on non-expired lease emits conflict.detected and must hold.
semantics.helpers: Helpers require explicit helper leases, never become primary owner, and expire no later than the owner lease.
semantics.write_scope: Primary leases may declare write_scope; overlapping active scopes require handoff/split or explicit collaboration before mutation.
semantics.fencing_token: Each successful primary claim increments a monotonic per-work fencing token. Late/stale holders must not mutate guarded state with an older token.
